findings.evidence: Downscaling cancels workers (`pkg/ddl/backfilling_scheduler.go:325` -> `pkg/ddl/backfilling.go:301` -> `pkg/ddl/backfilling.go:294`). A canceled worker drops its result because `sendResult` prefers `<-w.ctx.Done()` (`pkg/ddl/backfilling.go:382`). Worker errors are only surfaced by the result-collector returning `result.err` (`pkg/ddl/backfilling.go:963`), so a dropped result means the error is never observed. This PR adds a periodic adjust loop that calls `scheduler.adjustWorkerSize()` at runtime (`pkg/ddl/backfilling.go:1030`), making mid-backfill downscales realistic.
findings.fix: Make downscaling graceful: avoid canceling `backfillWorker.ctx` for workers that may be processing a task. Prefer self-throttling (semaphore/permit) or have workers stop only before taking the next task (after successfully sending the current task’s result). If cancellation is kept, ensure the current task’s result/error is still delivered (or the task is re-queued) before the worker exits.
findings.impact: A backfill error/panic on a worker canceled during a downscale can be silently ignored, allowing the DDL reorg/add-index to continue and potentially finish with missing/incorrect index data; panics can also be lost because the deferred `ErrReorgPanic` result uses `sendResult`.
findings.verify: Run ADD INDEX with failpoints (e.g. `mockBackfillRunErr` / a real duplicate-key error) while concurrently issuing `ADMIN ALTER DDL JOBS <job_id> THREAD=<smaller>` to trigger downscale; assert the job fails and the error is propagated/recorded (not silently succeeding). Then validate index completeness/consistency post-job.
findings.what: Shrinking txn-backfill concurrency can cancel workers in a way that drops in-flight task results (including errors/panics), so reorg/add-index may continue and complete even though some backfill tasks failed.

subject: ddl: dynamically adjusting the concurrency and batch size of reorganization job (#57468)
summary: Implements runtime tuning of reorg concurrency/batch size for txn backfill and local ingest; found a High-risk error-propagation hole when downscaling txn backfill workers due to result-dropping on worker cancellation.
